assumptions: Source meshes and their authored thickness/subdivision modifiers are evaluated without decimation. Material assignments are converted to vertex colors; no topology decimation or new anatomical muscle mesh is generated.
The atlas contains tendons/aponeuroses/supporting tissue alongside muscle meshes; counts distinguish these types.
Origin/insertion patches and bone names are unverified source annotations, including source inconsistencies.
No microscopic muscle fiber reconstruction, force simulation, or individual medical accuracy is claimed.
countNote: Per-object exportPolygons is pre-serialization evaluated polygon count. Final Blender source counts and glTF triangulation counts are recorded separately; exporter mesh cleanup may remove degenerate source faces. OriginalMuscleTopology preserves all 980434 raw vertices / 1953133 raw polygons.
